name: Vembanad Lake (JRC surface water)
description: Water state at the first and last year of the JRC record, derived from the transition layer.
source: European Commission JRC, Global Surface Water Explorer
product: JRC Global Surface Water transitions (v1.4, 2021 release)
format: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (derived from the original official file)
license: Free and open; cite Pekel et al. (2016)

provenance.license: Free and open; cite Pekel et al. (2016) Nature 540, 418-422.
provenance.temporal_coverage: First year (1984) versus last year (2021) water class transition
provenance.date_semantics: first year of the JRC record (1984), taken from the product's transition layer; not a single acquisition date
processing_operations: water state at each end derived from the 11 transition classes
provenance.limitation: Early Landsat coverage over India is sparse, so the 1984 state is less certain than the 2021 state. Floating vegetation and froth can hide water from this method.
